---
title: Manage Stamp Card
description: >-
  View stamp card configurations, modify rule settings, and duplicate or delete
  existing stamp cards.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Incentives > Stamp > Stamp Card List.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="335" height="218" style="width: 335px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Click a stamp to view details.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="590" height="271" style="width: 590px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3.

- Modify existing stamp details.

* Delete or duplicate stamp.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="433" height="150" style="width: 433px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
